verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting the cap table or transaction history to Excel/CSV. Vestd's digital cap table, data rooms (which can hold uploaded cap table files) and board-ready reporting are adjacent features, not an open-format export capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
